videos.title: Making money online basically comes down to two things...
videos.description:
Making money online basically comes down to two things - building something people want, and then actually selling it to them.

Most of us love the building part. It's fun, it's creative, you can use AI, whatever. But it's the selling that determines whether you're making money or just doing a hobby 👀

One of the best ways to sell is posting on social media, but then what happens is you would usually say "link in bio" and hope people see the post, go to your profile, find the link tree, click the right link. That's a lot of steps and you lose people at every single one 😅

This is exactly why we've been using Manychat for years. It's an official Meta business partner that turns your comments, DMs and story replies into actual results automatically - e-book downloads, webinar signups, email list growth, even direct sales.

It basically acts as your own follow-up system running 24/7, answering questions, sending links and showing people how to enrol, all in real time without you lifting a finger.

Building the thing is step one, but if you want a passive income empire, you need systems that sell even when you're not online 💸
